remarks: MUST SEE pristine turn-key 2 bedroom 2 full bathroom brick 3-floor townhouse with view of golf course in a desirable area of Stamford. First floor features: expansive living room leading into dining room, kitchen with updated appliances and access to a large private deck, and hardwood floors throughout. Second floor features: two spacious bedrooms (one currently gym/office) with deep closet space, full bathroom, and linen closet. Finished basement features: large family room, full bathroom, washer/dryer, and multiple deep closets / abundant storage space. Central A/C and natural gas heating. There are 2 assigned parking spaces near the front door and plenty of visitor parking. Townhouse has been recently painted, water heater replaced ~2 years ago, and hardwood floors are in great condition.  The townhouse is located in a coveted neighborhood; front door is across from golf course and back of complex is bordered by Rippowam River; walking distance to Scalzi Park, Ridgeway Shopping Center, and Stamford Hospital; close to downtown Stamford and public transportation; equidistant to I-95 and Merritt Parkway.
